messages:
maya: Heads up — I pushed seedling-x3b to dev/staging (route: /models/seedling-x3b/dev). Can folks run quick sanity: tokenization, short QA, length handling, determinism with seed? Here's a minimal curl to hit it:

curl -X POST https://dev.api.redwood/models/seedling-x3b/dev/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"Explain two-sentence summary of Redwood Inference","max_tokens":50}'

I care about: 1) tokens match reference tokenizer 2) no early truncation 3) stable outputs with seed 42 4) baseline latency (p95) for 32 tokens

any volunteers?

sam: on it. running token test now. will hit repeatability with seed. ETA 10m

reena: Quick FYI — saw different tokenizer mapping for '—' (em dash) on earlier q4 build. Will check.

toni: ran short QA. got answer but last sentence cut off after 48 tokens. paste: "Redwood Inference is a platform that..." Looks truncated.

jordan: can you paste the exact prompt + headers? might be prompt truncation or server-side max_tokens bug.

toni: prompt used: 'Summarize Redwood Inference in two sentences.' headers: content-type json, max_tokens 50 seeded 42. I'll paste response:

> Redwood Inference is a developer-first platform for running and optimizing large language model inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. It focuses on production-grade inference, model lifecycle, and tooling,

notice trailing comma and incomplete clause.

maya: @toni thanks. that's suspicious — could be tokenizer offset when counting tokens for EOS trimming. reena can you run tokenizer diff with ref vocab?

reena: doing token diffs now. found mismatch: em dash normalized to two tokens on dev model but one on ref. patch incoming to tokenizer mapping table.

sam: repeatability test with seed 42: two runs gave different outputs (minor wording). attaching snippets:

run1: '...focuses on production-grade inference and tooling to reduce cost.'
run2: '...focuses on production-grade inference and developer tooling to lower cost.'

suspect KV cache not warmed or nondeterministic batching.

jordan: also measure latency p95. my run: p95=210ms (32 token output) on g4dn-devpool. baseline expected ~180ms. will open infra ticket if persistent.

deploy-bot: Deployment notice: model seedling-x3b v1.0 deployed to dev-staging at 2026-11-02T14:12:05Z

maya: good notes. next actions: reena to land tokenizer map, sam to instrument deterministic mode and force single-request batching, jordan to re-run latency after a warmup sequence, toni to run short QA eval set and post failures. I'll create a minimal checklist file in repo.

toni: assigning myself QA set run now. will post failures as a short list.

reena: tokenizer patch is small; pushing PR now w/ test. tag @maya

sam: for quant experiments — I'm going to run int8 profile on this model in dev with batch size 1 and compare BLEU/QA. Will send results later.

maya: thanks all. we'll reconvene if any showstopper. :thumbsup:
